June 7, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
David Keidan decreased its stake in Tjx Companies Inc (TJX) by 4.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Buckingham Capital Management Inc sold 7,745 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.74% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by David Keidan held 156,097 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.73 million, down from 163,842 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Buckingham Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Tjx Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $59.17 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.36% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $94.64. About 2.11 million shares traded. The TJX Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TJX) has risen 16.90% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.33% the S&P500.
